findings.description: index.html uses offline KaTeX and local CSS styles correctly.
All 20 KaTeX woff2 font files exist in vendor/katex/fonts/.
CSS includes classes for question-card, option-btn, formula-card, and misconception-card, alongside responsive media queries.
8 view modules (home.js, curriculum.js, chapter.js, concept.js, formulas.js, practice.js, ladders.js, progress.js) and 4 support modules exist.
